description: This file defines types and utility functions related to handling channel send results within a plugin SDK. It deals with attaching channel information to various result objects, creating empty or standardized results, and adapting sending functions for different channels.

methods.name: export function attachChannelToResult<T extends object>(channel: string, result: T) { attachChannelToResult
methods.description: Attaches a channel identifier to a result object, returning a new object containing the channel and the original result data.

methods.name: export function attachChannelToResults<T extends object>(channel: string, results: readonly T[])/ attachChannelToResults
methods.description: Maps over an array of result objects, attaching a specified channel to each.

methods.name: export function createEmptyChannelResult( createEmptyChannelResult
methods.description: Creates a default OutboundDeliveryResult object for a specified channel, with optional overrides.

methods.name: export function createAttachedChannelResultAdapter(params: { createAttachedChannelResultAdapter
methods.description: Constructs an adapter object that wraps send functions (text, media, poll) to automatically attach a channel to their results.

methods.name: export function createRawChannelSendResultAdapter(params: { createRawChannelSendResultAdapter
methods.description: Builds an adapter that wraps send functions (text, media) to produce raw send results, normalized with channel info.

methods.name: export function buildChannelSendResult(channel: string, result: ChannelSendRawResult) { buildChannelSendResult
methods.description: Converts a raw ChannelSendRawResult into a standardized object including channel, status, message ID, and error.
